conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Mark Evans from the Amazon Legal Compliance Department. I'm calling regarding a security alert on your Amazon account. May I speak with Mr. Cody Mills?
Yes, this is Cody. What's going on with my account?

Thank you, Mr. Mills. For your protection, I want to reassure you this is a standard Amazon policy check, reference code APL-442. There appears to be a suspicious transaction attempt on your account, but we're here to assist you in resolving it safely.
Oh, I'm really worried. I lost my job recently and can't afford any problems like this.

I completely understand, and I want to assure you our priority is the security of your account and your funds. To proceed with the verification, can you confirm the email address associated with your Amazon account?
Sure, it's codymills@email.com.
Thank you, Mr. Mills. For further validation under policy APL-442, could you verify the last four digits of the phone number registered to your Amazon account?
Perfect, thank you for confirming. According to our logs, there was an order placed for a MacBook Pro valued at $2,499, shipping to an address in New York. Did you initiate this transaction?
No, definitely not. I never ordered that.

Understood. To prevent any financial loss, we'll need to temporarily suspend your account and reverse the unauthorized purchase. As part of Amazon's security process, I'll walk you through a few steps. Are you at a computer or smartphone now?
Yes, I'm on my laptop.
Excellent. Please open your web browser and navigate to www.amazonaccountsafety.com. This is our secure customer verification portal for incident cases like yours.
Okay, I'm there. It's asking me for a reference code.
Please enter policy code APL-442 and click 'Proceed.' You'll see a prompt to verify your identity. Enter your full name exactly as it appears on your Amazon account.
Done. It wants my birthdate too?
Yes, that's correct. This helps us confirm your account isn't compromised. Once you enter your birthdate, let me know what the portal displays.
Now it says, 'Account Flagged: Immediate Action Required.'

That's expected. Because of the high-value unauthorized purchase, Amazon policy requires a temporary security deposit to verify ownership and unlock the refund process. This amount is fully refundable after verification.
What does that mean? I have to pay something?

Yes, but only temporarily. Under our anti-fraud protocol, a $500 Amazon Gift Card must be applied to verify identity. This measure is enforced by policy code SEC-101. Once verified, the full amount will be refunded to your account within 24 hours.
But I really can't afford to lose $500 right now.

I completely understand your concern, Mr. Mills. The deposit is strictly for verification and will not be retained by Amazon. It's a required security step to ensure no fraudulent activity continues on your account.
So I just need to buy a gift card and give you the code?

Correct. Please purchase an Amazon Gift Card for $500 from a local retailer or online, and then enter the claim code into the portal when prompted. I can remain on the line to assist and answer any questions.
Alright, let me check my balance. Okay, I can do this if it's refunded.
Thank you for your cooperation. Once you have the gift card, enter the code on the portal or, if you prefer, provide it to me and I'll process the verification immediately.
I just bought the card. The code is 7YHD-KL9P-M3VZ-RT5S.
Thank you, Mr. Mills. I am processing your verification now. Please remain patient, as this step ensures your account is only accessible by you.
Will this stop the fake order from going through?

Yes, once the verification is complete, the MacBook purchase will be immediately canceled and the pending charge reversed. Additionally, your refund will be processed no later than the end of business day tomorrow.
Okay. Is there anything else I need to do?
One last step: as per updated Amazon protocols, we recommend a secondary verification. This involves a $200 Google Play gift card, which is also refundable. Would you be able to purchase this today?
I guess so, if I have to. I'm just worried this is a scam.

I appreciate your diligence, Mr. Mills. If you wish, you may verify our policy code SEC-101 on the Amazon support website for your peace of mind. This procedure is standard for high-risk account cases and ensures your safety.
Alright, I'll get the Google Play card and enter it on the portal.
Thank you for your prompt action. After you complete this step, your account will be fully cleared and you will receive all refunds as documented in your case file.
